Rudra Asthana

Welcome to my digital garden. I am a student, writer, and open-source tinkerer. I built this space to cultivate my notes in plain text, prioritizing reading comfort and clean typography over algorithmic timelines.

My interests are scattered across a few different disciplines. I am deeply interested in physics research and the logistics of climate change solutions, while simultaneously exploring Indian constitutional history and modern Hindi literature. On a given weekend, you will usually find me reading Khaled Hosseini, exploring the financial markets on Zerodha, or volunteering as an editor on Wikipedia.

Projects & Hobbies

I have a strong background in Model United Nations, having served enthusiastically as a Director General, Vice-Chairperson, and Executive Board member. I spent a significant amount of time drafting procedural frameworks and background guides for various committees.

Digitally, I am passionate about Linux customization. I daily-drive Arch Linux and spend time writing Bash scripts, formatting complex documents in LaTeX, and experimenting with Python, Go, and C++. When I want to disconnect, I usually spin up Genshin Impact, Minecraft, or Ultrakill.
